query.warehouse_id: Required UUID, must match confirmed authenticated warehouse

request.identity: Exact persisted UUID only. SKU and arbitrary raw-code resolution are not accepted by these detail routes; retain the ID from the existing approved resolver/catalog/BOX owner.
request.conditional_cache: Rejected by explicit-read-fields-v1; request a fresh no-store response.

authorization.common: Fresh ACTIVE actor, current stable authenticated family, confirmed READY warehouse context, canAccessWarehouse and actual active sku.view grant.
authorization.box_identity: At least one active grant: container.view, putaway.view, putaway.manage; existing route middleware also remains active.
authorization.item_identity: Active item_instance.view grant; existing route middleware remains active.
authorization.placement: Active putaway.view OR putaway.manage grant. Without it, identity/master may be read but current_location is omitted with REDACTED_PERMISSION. No placement source query or location label is returned.
authorization.grant_source: User.activeRoles with effective dates and scope_ref null/empty or the confirmed warehouse, ACTIVE role_permission/permission, plus ACTIVE user_permission. Role code or display name alone does not grant this new capability.
authorization.scope: This revision requires exactly one persisted ACTIVE warehouse row. A second inactive warehouse also fails closed until global registry ownership is modeled; selected query warehouse is never placement proof.
authorization.tenant: Compare trusted actor/warehouse tenant_id, org_id, organization_id when present; filter every source with those dimensions. An unresolvable tenant-scoped source fails 503. With no tenant columns, require a single-tenant database; no cross-tenant capability is claimed.
authorization.revalidation: Compare identity, current context, actor version, dimensions and actual grants after the read snapshot. Committed scope changes fail closed.

source_mapping.box_identity: containers.container_id/container_code, container_type=BOX. container_code is a physical BOX code, not SKU.
source_mapping.item_identity: item_instances.item_id; physical_code only from exactly one ACTIVE physical_codes row assigned_object_type=ITEM, assigned_object_id=item_id, carrier_type QR or BARCODE. Compatibility item_code/serial is not physical-code proof; ambiguity omits code with SOURCE_INCONSISTENT.
source_mapping.master: Exact sku join from ITEM.sku_id or BOX.primary_sku_id. sku_id/sku_code/sku_name/unit are current directory values, never historical snapshots. Known non-COMPONENT SKU is rejected; missing labels are omitted and explained.
source_mapping.warehouse_id: Confirmed authorized registry/context warehouse, labeled SINGLE_WAREHOUSE_REGISTER_NOT_PHYSICAL_PLACEMENT. current_location.warehouse_id separately requires persisted putaway/receipt ownership.
source_mapping.placement: Latest unambiguously timed putaway_events with status CONFIRMED for the exact box_container_id, matching container_id alias, warehouse_id, to_tray_id/to_parent_container_id and current BOX.parent_container_id. Requires actual TRAY, usable status, BOX status STORED or PARTIAL and a nondeleted POSTED receipt in the same dst_warehouse_id.
source_mapping.current_record_rule: Draft/cancelled putaways never supersede a confirmation. Ambiguous confirmation times, missing/invalid/future confirmed_at, mismatched parent/aliases or invalid receipt/TRAY fail SOURCE_INCONSISTENT. No event => NOT_RECORDED. A newer confirmation never falls back to an older apparently usable one.
source_mapping.item_inheritance: Exactly one ACTIVE/is_active container_items ITEM-mode row with matching item_id and item_instances.container_id. ERD ITEM-mode has sku_id=null and quantity=null; SKU derives from exact ITEM and must match BOX.primary_sku_id. Requires ITEM IN_STOCK and a valid membership version; otherwise no inference.
source_mapping.location: Actual TRAY containers.container_id/container_code. location_label equals its actual code and is labeled ACTUAL_CONTAINER_CODE_NOT_SHELF_OR_BIN. This does not invent shelf/bin identity or a full warehouse grid.
source_mapping.effective_at: putaway_events.confirmed_at only, document-timestamps-v1 RFC3339 UTC Z. Existing naive putaway storage follows the documented Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh legacy convention; explicit offsets preserve instant. No created_at/updated_at/Date.now substitute.
source_mapping.observed_at: Response database snapshot observation time, not placement effective time.
source_mapping.versions: Persisted putaway_events.version, containers.version for BOX and TRAY, plus exact membership ID/version for inherited ITEM placement.
source_mapping.excluded: location_hint, zone_code, free-form notes, shared SKU counts, readiness and current lookup cannot establish placement. No audit actor/customer PII is exposed.

response.missing: Omit the missing value path. Explain it in meta.read_fields.missing_fields with path, status, source=AUTHORIZED_OWNER_RESPONSE, value_supplied=false. No null or fabricated empty/zero value in a successful explicit representation.
response.hierarchy_capacity: Omit + NOT_CONFIGURED. Neither hierarchy nor capacity is needed for a valid current TRAY location.
response.cache_policy: NO_INTERNAL_RESULT_CACHE; SINGLE_RESPONSE_DATABASE_SNAPSHOT, not a cross-request frozen snapshot.

errors.409: Unsupported or missing contract / unconfirmed context
errors.422: Invalid query/body/conditional headers or known non-COMPONENT SKU

acceptance: Source tests and deployment do not imply positive live ITEM placement or App/device UAT PASS. Live data without proof stays absent, never seeded/repaired to obtain evidence.
